inj.detail: Activated from IR (hamstring/quad) for MNF vs. DAL
inj.note: Officially activated from injured reserve Monday afternoon alongside fellow tight end Grant Calcaterra and guard Landon Dickerson to play Monday night against Dallas. Dallas Goedert remains the clear TE1 while Stowers and Calcaterra provide TE2/TE3 depth.
